pages.hook: In a burger place in Milwaukee, you say your order, hear one question about a combo and move on. Learn how to order fast food without stress.

mythfact.s: A combo meal usually includes a main food, fries and a drink.
mythfact.why: A burger combo is typically a burger, fries and a drink in one price.

mythfact.s: In the USA, people always call a soft drink “cola”.
mythfact.why: Many say “soda”, and some regions say “pop” or the brand name.

mythfact.s: Milwaukee is in the state of Wisconsin.
mythfact.why: It is the biggest city in Wisconsin, on Lake Michigan.

mythfact.s: It is rude to say “No, thanks. That’s all.”
mythfact.why: It is a normal and polite way to end an order.

mythfact.s: “A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving” is an animated TV special with the Peanuts characters.
mythfact.why: It is based on Charles Schulz’s Peanuts and first aired in 1973.

decode.q: How much more is the combo than the burger alone?

compare.br: In Brazil, a “combo” or “promoção” at a lanchonete is also common, and you may order at a counter or from an app.
compare.us: In the USA, the cashier usually asks “Do you want a combo?” and “Anything else?”.
compare.tip: Say “No, thanks. That’s all.” to finish your order.
compare.ask: What is your favorite fast-food combo? Say it in English.

quiz.q: The cashier asks: “Do you want a combo?” You want to know what is in it. You say…
quiz.why: What comes with it? asks about the extras.

quiz.q: You do not want anything else. You say…
quiz.why: That’s all = I want nothing more.

quiz.q: The cashier says “Enjoy your burger!” You answer…

pages.title: Reading quest — My burger day · part 1
text: I am in **Milwaukee**, and I am very hungry. It is almost Thanksgiving, and I think about a big turkey dinner. Today, my friend Gus takes me to a burger place.

The cashier, Malik, smiles. “**Welcome! What can I get you?**” I say, “**A cheeseburger, please.**” He asks, “**Do you want a combo?**” I am not sure, so I ask, “**What comes with it?**” “**Fries and a drink**,” he says.

That sounds good. “**OK. A combo, and a cola.**” “**Anything else?**” “**No, thanks. That’s all.**” Gus laughs because he wants lemonade and extra ketchup. The tray is full: a burger, fries and a cold drink.

pages.title: Reading quest — My burger day · part 2
text: “**Enjoy your burger!**” Malik says. I take a big bite. It is hot and tasty. Gus says, “**Let’s supersize it!**” but I say, “No, I feel full.” That is a good ending: not too much, not too little.

The TV special A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving is about friends and a dinner, and it talks about being thankful. I am grateful for Gus and for a good burger. Next time I will say, “I’m so hungry!” again, but maybe I will order a salad.

Malik says: “Do you want a combo?” — what is the natural reply?
Malik says: “Fries and a drink.” — what is the natural reply?
opts: No drink, I am a cola.
OK. A combo, and a cola.

qs.q: Malik says: “Anything else?” — what is the natural reply?

retell.prompt: Retell the conversation in your own words.

pages.story: You are at a burger place in Milwaukee. Malik is the cashier. Order a combo and finish politely.

turns.npc: Welcome! What can I get you?

opts.fb: A good question when you are not sure.
Combo is a noun, not a verb.

opts.en: No drink, I am a cola.
opts.pt: Sem bebida, eu sou uma cola.

opts.en: OK. A combo, and a cola.
opts.pt: Ok. Um combo e uma cola.
opts.fb: Choose the combo and the drink.

items.linked: I am thankful for my family.

speed.q: Complete a fala: “Nah, I'm ____.” (Nah, estou de dieta.)
Complete a fala: “Fine, ____.” (Tá bom, você venceu.)

dict.say: Welcome! What can I get you?

errors.wrong: I want a combo with the cola.
errors.fix: I’ll have a combo with a cola.
errors.why: Use a before a drink, and I’ll have… is common when ordering.
Do not use a double negative. Say That’s all.

errors.alt: What is come with the combo?
errors.why: With it/what, use comes (third person).
In English, hungry is a feeling with be: I am hungry.
